sql: SELECT uri, author, posted_at, text, d['topic']['answer'] AS topic, d['topic']['confidence'] AS topic_sure, d['heat']['answer'] AS heat, d['newsworthy']['value'] AS newsworthy FROM (SELECT uri, author, posted_at, text, prompt_jev(text, '{"topic":{"type":"choice","instructions":"What is this post mainly about?","criteria":{"news":"Current events, politics, or something that just happened in the world.","technology":"Software, hardware, science, or the industry around them.","culture":"Art, music, film, books, games, or fandom.","sport":"Matches, players, results, or following a team.","personal":"The writer''s own day, feelings, work, pets, or family.","other":"None of the above, or too short to tell."}},"heat":{"type":"score","instructions":"How heated is the writing, judging by its tone rather than its subject.","criteria":["calm","opinionated","angry"]},"newsworthy":{"type":"noul","instructions":"This post reports something that actually happened and that a news desk would want to look into."}}') AS d FROM sampled)
